Build your first automation

Universe’26 · Section 2

Turn a new issue into a suggested fix and a draft pull request. You review before anything merges.

What is an automation?

A saved agent task that runs on a schedule, on demand, or in response to a repository event.

In this tutorial, you'll turn a skill into an automation, connect to an MCP server, and review the draft PR for security issues. Start with a manual trigger; add a schedule later.
